decisions.reason: The quantified six-figure savings quote and the product's fit with the firm's modular-solutions direction signal strong performance and visible commitment, so escalation of commitment makes dropping very unlikely.
Having its own page indicates visible public commitment and investment, and after only one year any disappointing results can still be attributed to temporary market introduction.

Although it is only mentioned on the website and lacks a quantified result, the product fits the announced modular-solutions direction and is still within the one-year window where weak results can be seen as temporary.

The weaker website presence and absence of reported results reduce the justification for strong commitment, but the product is close to the established offer and only one year old, so temporary-cause attributions still favor keeping it.
